report: Regelrechte Artikulations- und Stellungsverhältnisse im Kniegelenk. Keine relevanten Degenerationen. Bonebruise am medialen Femurkondylus (5/94). Ansonsten allseits regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Kein Hinweis auf eine Fraktur. Keine höhergradige Chondropathie femoropatellar und femorotibial. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband sowie lateraler Kollateralbandapparat intakt. Diffus Flüssigkeit entlang des mittleren bis distalen, nicht aufgetriebenen MCL bei erhaltener bandintegrität. Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne intakt ohne Signalalteration. Regelrechte Konfiguration der teils gering mukoiden Menisken, kein H.a. eine Rissbildung. Geringer Gelenkerguss. Kleine Baker-Zyste.

Indication: Right knee pain for a week.

TECHNIQUE:

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
No acute fracture. Mild osseous contusion at the lateral femoral condyle and medial patellar facet. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:

Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Laxity of the MPFL without high-grade tear.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Severe lateral patellar tilt and translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 21 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Sequela of recent transient lateral patellar dislocation with mild osseous contusions at the lateral femoral condyle and medial patella. 
2. Laxity of the medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) without high-grade tear.

FINDINGS:

There is a moderate knee joint effusion with synovitis. There is no popliteal cysts.

There are moderate to severe degenerative changes. More specifically there are severe changes in the medial compartment with full-thickness cartilage loss of the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is diffuse mild to moderate thinning of the cartilage in the lateral and patellofemoral compartments with no other regions of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There is diffuse intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL with intraosseous ganglion cyst at the insertion on the tibia. The PCL is intact.

There is diffuse intrasubstance degeneration with maceration, extrusion and degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Moderate to severe degenerative changes most pronounced medially.

2. Diffuse intrasubstance degeneration with maceration, extrusion and degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus. Intrasubstance degeneration of the lateral meniscus without tear.

3. Intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL without ligament injury.

4. Knee joint effusion with synovitis without popliteal cyst.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküste grade II  dejenerasyon izlendi.   Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve meniskal kök yırtığının eşlik ettiği kompleks yırtık izlendi. Medial menisküs ekstrüde görünümdedir.Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde periligamentöz ödem izlendi ve ligamende sinyal artışı mevcuttur ( grade II sprain ).Arka çapraz bağ, ön çapraz bağ, lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur. Patellar kıkırdak medial faset düzeyinde yer yer kıkırdakta incelme ve subkondral milimetrik kist, ödem izlendi ( grade IV kondromalazi ). Suprapatellar bursada diz eklemi içerisinde yaygın sıvı artışı  ve sinoviumda kalınlaşma  ( bursit  ve sinovit )  izlendi. Eklem kapsülü komşuluğunda yaygın ödematöz görünüm ve fokal kapsülde bütünlük kaybı, komşuluğunda büyüğü 12 mm çapta kistler izlendi.Femur interkondiler düzey anteriorlateralde  9x4 mm boyutlarında osteokondral defekt ve komşuluğunda kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitis sivrileşmeler , tibiofemoral eklem mesafesinde daralma , komşu kartilajlarda incelme ve subkondral ödem izlendi(dejeneratif artit bulguları). Tibia interkondiler tüberkül düzeyinde ve medial plato düzeyinde subkondral kistler ve kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.
